packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 until 26 is tested. This covers the node image, node-version in setup-node (looked up as actions/node-versions), .nvmrc, engines and @types/node.

The OpenCloud base images follow floating upstream tags (production its major, rolling :latest, see Dockerfile), and the weekly rebuild in build.yml keeps them current. Renovate would only propose digest pins, one PR per upstream build.
Static gosu privilege-drop helper image (multi-stage COPY --from)
GitHub Actions: auto-merge all updates. No CI runs on PRs, so platformAutomerge merges as soon as the PR is open.
Go in lint.yml (setup-go) and the golang build image in the Dockerfile move together and wait for review, so lint tests the toolchain the image builds with.
Node in lint.yml (setup-node) and the node build image in the Dockerfile move together and wait for review, for the same reason.
Docker: auto-merge digest pins and digest refreshes (same tag, new build). Major/minor stay open for review.
pnpm refuses lockfile entries published less than a day ago, so Renovate waits just as long before it opens the PR
vue-tsc loads TypeScript through its JavaScript API, which the native TypeScript 7 does not ship
The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
